main.description: The main window: the app's own chat, connections, tools, the organization's switches and the read-only views (audit log, notes, pack, approvals inbox). Local pages only: no capability here names a remote origin, so the session page shown in the window's sandboxed frame (http://127.0.0.1) gets no access to the app. Widening changes (a connection, a switch turned on, a tool installed) are confirmed by the person in the app's own code (Touch ID, the account password or Windows Hello), not here; text from the AI, data, files and sessions is shown as text, never markup; a strict CSP allows no remote script. The API key can be set or cleared but never read. Approvals from other AI apps are only listed: the person decides on the browser page the session opens. See docs/reference.md, 'Companion window and desktop app'.

sessions.description: The classic session list window: lists sessions and opens their windows or the classic settings window. Session windows show the local Columbus page and have no capabilities.

settings.description: The classic settings window (kept beside the main window until it has proved itself) may change connections, the organization's switches and the person's own tools, as the main window may. Changes that widen access are confirmed by the person (Touch ID, the account password or Windows Hello) in the app's own code, not here.
